name: Burn Bar
author: nixfred
description: Live thermal heat map of Claude, Codex and the Ollama on your Jetson in one bar slot, with weekly quota gauges, remote model control, and the share of tokens kept off frontier models.

barWidget.description: Token spend as a heat map — Claude burns left, Codex right, newest at the centre, and a live lane for the Ollama box on the far right.

schema.label: History window (minutes)
schema.description: How far back the cloud lanes reach. 360 = six hours.

schema.label: Plan-limit refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often Burn Bar asks Omarchy's own usage collectors for fresh Claude and Codex plan limits.

schema.label: Show local intelligence lane
schema.description: Live load of the Ollama box on the right of the strip.

schema.label: Local poll interval (ms)
schema.description: Each poll is one HTTP call and one ssh round trip to the Ollama box.

schema.label: Local inference threshold (%)
schema.description: Load above this counts as actively inferencing.

schema.label: Ollama URL
schema.description: Where Ollama answers. Through ollama-meter when it is installed there, so every request is counted.

schema.label: Ollama box (ssh host)
schema.description: An alias from your ssh config. Hardware telemetry, the token journal and the pre-load cache drop go over it; it must log in without a prompt.

schema.label: Meter systemd unit
schema.description: The ollama-meter unit on that box whose journal carries one line per request. Local token counts and the offload share come from there.

schema.label: Ember flicker
schema.description: Live flicker on hot cells. Turn off to save a little GPU.

schema.label: Rising sparks
schema.description: Embers lifting off the strip while anything is burning.
